bio: Hello Class of 2029, I am excited to serve you as Proctor! I have been proctoring since 2023. Aside proctoring, I work as a researcher at the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health. There, I work on using infectious disease models to support public health decision-making on diseases such as tuberculosis and malaria. I also teach graduate courses in infectious disease modeling. I was born in Ghana, where I also received a bachelor’s degree in mathematics and statistics. In 2022, I earned my PhD in Statistics at the University of Oxford on a Rhodes Scholarship. I live in residence with my family and we look forward to meeting you all! Community Yards Oak Yard Area Proctors Role Proctors
